purpose: Freeze one known false-stand-down discovery case and one matched restraint control before prompts, schemas, or provider results can influence semantic review.

frozen_source_first_target.unresolved_matter: The bounded pilot does not establish what can legitimately generalize from two medical wards in the only participating city with accessible vehicles, or which safeguards depend on temporary coordination and attention.
frozen_source_first_target.reopen_condition: Continuation or wider transfer should reopen the setting-validity, staffing, privacy, transport-supply, and steady-state support questions rather than treating acceptable local pilot metrics as sufficient.
frozen_source_first_target.cross_thread_relationship: The current position is a bounded local pilot, while the unresolved and reopen records limit what that pilot can justify about continuation or generalization.

pass_dimensions.material_pressure_recovered: At least one admitted uncertainty record materially recovers the cross-setting or temporary-support gap without inventing an outside fact.
pass_dimensions.evidence_precision: Every admitted record cites exact source aliases that support its own meaning and modal force.
pass_dimensions.role_placement: The unresolved matter, the event or evidence that would reopen the position, and their relationship are separately inspectable rather than collapsed into one prose field.
pass_dimensions.relationship_fidelity: Any relationship uses exact admitted record IDs and explains the limiting or reopening relationship without rewriting endpoint records.

frozen_source_first_target.restraint_expectation: No distinct material unresolved or reopen record is expected beyond the explicit six-month evidence and decision-travel review already built into the current position.
frozen_source_first_target.existing_reopen_structure: The final conversation already asks what results changed, whether unwelcome information still travels upward, and preserves records that distinguish executive ability, mandate, founder interference, organizational resistance, and changed conditions.
frozen_source_first_target.cross_thread_relationship: If the paired reader returns no new unresolved or reopen record, the relationship reader should also be able to complete with zero rather than manufacture a relationship from the starting and current positions alone.

pass_dimensions.false_positive_restraint: Risks, monitoring language, or a future review already operationalized in the current position do not automatically become a new unresolved matter or reopen condition.
pass_dimensions.evidence_precision: Any non-zero record must cite exact source evidence for a genuinely distinct remaining matter, not merely restate a safeguard.
pass_dimensions.relationship_restraint: The relationship reader may complete with zero and does not invent a relationship merely because two position records exist.

non_claims: A two-case diagnostic is not a reliability, usefulness, production-model, graph-value, or real-user claim.
A schema-valid or locally admitted record is not proof of semantic correctness.
A completed-zero control is not proof that no other human interpretation exists.
Recovering the frozen target does not prove that the revised answer or final decision improves.
The target file is review evidence only and must never be included in a provider request.
